text: No, there's RIR, there are percentages, and there's RPE. There are so many ways to ideally put it together. I like RIR in my model, so that's what I'm going to be using. We can also add the explanation of RIR and kind of mix it with RPE, and those two are more subjective. Everything in training is kind of subjective. It's very hard to get an objective opinion when someone's tired and their body's hurting and things like that, so that's very important for us to get right, as close as we can.
